summary: Full stabilization pass on Revenue Rescue. Backend: created /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (22 pytest cases covering benchmark generate/clear, system status, overview metrics, opportunities ranking, event detail, recovery execute + policy + idempotency, audit trail + filters, simulator, experiments, root-causes, policies GET/PUT persistence, pagination/filters). All 22 pass when run serially (pytest -n 0). Frontend: E2E via Playwright on the public URL — Overview, DataLoaderModal (default 150), Revenue At Risk, Opportunities, Simulator (7 strategies + Scenario B WAIT recommended), Audit Trail (+filters), Root Causes (6 clusters + 3 breakdowns), Experiments, Policies (save works), Recovery Plans, Settings, Clear-Data empty state, environment selector (no Production). Scenarios A, D, E verified end-to-end. Scenario C (policy block) FAILED — policy ceiling is bypassed and the ₹78,500 event is marked RECOVERED. Dataset was restored to demo initial state at the end (150 events, 000001 FAILED, 000003 ESCALATED, 000004 CAPTURED).

critical.issue: Policy ceiling bypass: guard is `if amount > human_approval_threshold and action != 'ESCALATE TO HUMAN'`. EVENT_BENCH_000003 (₹78,500) has decision_card.action='ESCALATE TO HUMAN', and the EventDrawer sends exactly that action, so the request skips the block and the endpoint marks the event status=RECOVERED, inserts a CAPTURED attempt and ALLOWED audit rows, returning status=SUCCESS/amount_recovered=78500. Scenario C never blocks in the real demo flow (only blocks if a caller passes a different action). Fix: block on amount>threshold regardless of action, and/or treat 'ESCALATE TO HUMAN' as an approval-request action that must NOT set status=RECOVERED or capture funds.

minor.issue: Response is truncated to items[:50] but total_expected_recovery/total_expected_incremental_recovery are summed over ALL items — totals do not match the displayed rows (UI shows ₹17,65,823 pipeline vs 50 visible rows). Also demo hero EVENT_BENCH_000001 (₹4,999) is outside the top 50 (sorting is by absolute incremental value), so the scripted demo step 'open EVENT_BENCH_000001 from /opportunities' is impossible.

Clusters overlap/double count: 31+80+39+0+14+1 = 165 for a 150-event dataset (e.g. EVENT_BENCH_000001 appears in customer_level AND already_recovered; 000005 in customer_level AND low_probability). Cluster amounts therefore double count revenue.
uncertain_state cluster is always 0 — the generator never emits PENDING/WAITING statuses, so one of the six judge-facing cluster cards is permanently empty.
available_merchants returns only MERCH_ACME_IN and MERCH_RAZOR_SANDBOX, but the TopHeader dropdown hardcodes a third merchant 'Nova SaaS Technologies' — frontend/backend mismatch.

baseline_interventions is computed as one retry per event for BOTH recovered and open events via duplicated branches (lines ~684-690 collapse to the same code) — dead/duplicated logic; also experiment_config says 'Naive single blind retry' while the UI header says 'BASELINE (3 STATIC RETRIES)'.

ui_bugs.issue: Executing ₹78,500 EVENT_BENCH_000003 shows the GREEN 'Lifecycle Execution Verified … ₹78,500 Recovered' block plus a success toast; execution-blocked-block never renders. Drawer logic is correct — root cause is the backend guard exemption for action='ESCALATE TO HUMAN'.

Demo hero EVENT_BENCH_000001 is not present in the ranked table (rank > 50), so opp-inspect-btn-EVENT_BENCH_000001 does not exist. Add a search/filter or pin showcase scenarios if the demo script requires opening it from this page.
Timestamps render raw ISO with microseconds ('2026-09-03 16:49:39.932907+00:00') for newly executed rows while seeded rows show clean values — format consistently.

integration_issues.issue: Frontend sends decisionCard.action to /api/recovery/execute; because the backend exempts 'ESCALATE TO HUMAN' from the ₹50,000 ceiling, a REQUIRES_APPROVAL event gets auto-'recovered' — the guardrail story breaks and revenue_recovered/experiments metrics get inflated by ₹78,500.

rca_of_the_issue: Scenario C failure RCA: /api/recovery/execute guard is `if amount > policy.human_approval_threshold and action != 'ESCALATE TO HUMAN'`. EventDrawer.handleExecute posts action = decisionCard.action, which for EVENT_BENCH_000003 is 'ESCALATE TO HUMAN' — the exempted value — so the ceiling check is skipped, the event is flipped to RECOVERED with a CAPTURED attempt and two ALLOWED audit rows, and the drawer renders execution-verification-block instead of execution-blocked-block. Reproduce: POST /api/recovery/execute {event_id:'EVENT_BENCH_000003', action:'ESCALATE TO HUMAN'} on a freshly generated dataset → status SUCCESS, amount_recovered 78500. Mitigation: evaluate the amount ceiling before any action-specific branching and give ESCALATE TO HUMAN its own non-capturing outcome (e.g. status='ESCALATED_FOR_APPROVAL').
